correctness.rationale: The reciprocal change z=1/x converts unforced updates to f(z)=(z+1)/R and pulse to f(z)+(s/R)z(z+1). The exact final reciprocal f^n(z0)+(s/R^n)H_t, H_t=R^t z_t(z_t+1), decouples dose. For R≠1, H_t=R/(R-1)^2 R^t+(2/(R-1)+1)(z0-1/(R-1))+(z0-1/(R-1))² R^(-t), strictly convex in real t; for R=1, H_t=(z0+t)(z0+t+1) is strictly convex. For R≤1 discrete differences >0 imply last unique. For R>1 exact H_(n-1)-H_0 factors with one attainable positive threshold xcrit=(R-1)/(1+R^(n/2)); first below, last above, endpoint tie at equality, interior strictly excluded. Independent exact Fraction test of terminal vs formula and both sides of switch passed; it does not prove all real cases.
